capabilities: Track download counts for a user-defined list of plugins and themes
Draw a 30-day trend curve from daily sampling of official stats files
Backfill 30 days of plugin history from the stats file's git commits
Link each tracked item to its store listing and GitHub repository
Show totals and per-item rows in the status bar and a right-sidebar view
extras: README is written in Chinese. Privacy section: only anonymous GET requests to public Obsidian stats files, no telemetry. Explains that download counts measure installs plus updates, not unique users.
problem: Obsidian's community directory only shows a current cumulative download number, with no way to watch how a set of plugins or themes grows over time.

summary: Status-bar and sidebar panel that tracks download counts for the community plugins and themes you follow, with a 30-day curve, totals, and per-item rows.
